description: Search cities, venues, production titles, performers, editorial collections, or categories. Use kind all with a query for mixed results. Supply a city with kind category for dated occurrence counts; the kids entry counts events for children. Performer and editorial results are compact; use their detail tools next.

scope.description: Venue and title scope. Defaults to Sofia, except kind all, which defaults to every city.
